text:
Priya (CS): dropping a quick rollup from today's onboarding batch. repeating asks across 5 accounts: 1) single-click export of feature asks (CSV) for product, 2) clearer per-route cost callouts in Console, 3) embedders re-run trigger after model updates, 4) onboarding checklist progress metric per account.
Marco (PM): thanks. can CS attach severity + renewal window for each ask? that makes triage actionable.
Priya (CS): yes. format i'll use: `account, tier, renewal_date, ask, quote, severity(1-5)`. will send ~8 rows.
Dev (SE): initial effort guesstimates: CSV export -> 1 dev day (backend job + small UI link); cost callouts -> 2w (aggregation + UI); re-run embeddings -> depends if we allow customer-triggered jobs (~3-5d + safety guards); checklist metric -> add field in account table + small UI ~4d.
Sam (Enablement): for the checklist metric, we can reuse the Enablement onboarding deck and add links into Console. want to own the copy A/B.
Priya (CS): sample verbatim quotes: "We can't tell which route burned our credits — support only sees totals." and "When you swapped models our semantic search degraded; we need a way to re-embed without waiting 48h."
Marco (PM): prioritization suggestion: 1) CSV export (fast), 2) cost callouts banner experiment (fast-ish), 3) re-embed trigger (needs infra review), 4) checklist metric (enablement owns UX).
Priya (CS): propose scoring each raw ask with: `score = (renewal_urgency*4) + (tier_weight*3) + (customer_impact*2)` where tier_weight Enterprise=3/ Mid=2/ SMB=1 and renewal_urgency = (days_to_renew <=30 ? 5 : 1). i'll surface anything >=12 as high.
Dev (SE): can we get `route.token_usage.daily` telemetry and `embed.job.triggered_by` flag? we'll need those to safely expose re-embed and to show per-route callouts.
triage-bot: created ticket CS-82419 "Feature-asks CSV export" and CS-82420 "Cost callouts - banner experiment". CS-82419 assigned -> @Marco, CS-82420 -> @Dev.
Marco (PM): i'll take CS-82419 since it's small. can CS attach the CSV sample (headers + 3 rows) to ticket? makes it easy for SE to validate.
Priya (CS): attaching quick sample in thread: ```account,tier,renewal_date,ask,quote,severity
AcmeCorp,Enterprise,2024-09-12,"Export of feature asks","We need a CSV to share with our PMs",4
NovaLLC,Mid,2024-12-01,"Per-route cost visibility","Our bot spiked and we saw the bill later",5
Zephyr,SMB,2025-01-15,"Re-embed trigger","Search got worse after model swap",3```
Sam (Enablement): will draft the banner copy and a 15s microvideo for the Console; can we run banner to a 10% experiment on trial accounts?
Dev (SE): yes, feature-flag rollout is fine. i'll add a check in the ticket re: throttling re-embed jobs and requiring `embed.job.triggered_by = "user"` in logs.
Priya (CS): outreach plan for high-scoring items: i'll route to Account Leads and propose a quick remediation call template. sample outreach line: "We heard your concern about unexpected token usage — we're shipping a short-term banner and CSV export to help surface route usage. Can we schedule 20m to review?"
Marco (PM): good. add a renewal contact field in the CSV so AMs can triage.
Priya (CS): will include `account_id, AM, renewal_date` in the final export. batching the scored list + quotes and pushing to CS-82419 by EOD.
Dev (SE): i'll scope CS-82420 (banner) as an on-call hotfix for next week; full per-route dashboard will be a follow-up project.
Sam (Enablement): will prep enablement playbook updates and a short script for AMs to use in the remediation calls.
Priya (CS): thanks all. next steps: CS uploads scored CSV -> PM confirms tickets & priority -> SE wires telemetry + quick wins. ping if anyone needs raw account IDs sooner. :thumbsup:
